from_quote: the mode of appointing the judges; this is the same with that of appointing the officers of the Union in general
rationale: Names "the mode of appointing the judges," which it says is the same as that for the officers of the Union discussed in the two preceding papers, where this clause was quoted.

from_quote: that it shall pass no bills of attainder, no ex-post-facto laws, and the like
rationale: The paragraph gives "no bills of attainder, no ex-post-facto laws" as instances of exceptions to the legislative authority, echoing this clause's words. Low because it offers them as a general example of what a limited constitution contains rather than naming this clause, and the same words also appear in the prohibitions on the States in Article I, Section 10.
to_quote: No Bill of Attainder or ex post facto Law shall be passed.

from_quote: the convention acted wisely in copying from the models of those constitutions which have established GOOD BEHAVIOR as the tenure of their judicial offices
rationale: Returns to the tenure quoted from this clause in the sixth paragraph, repeating "GOOD BEHAVIOR" in capitals as the tenure the convention adopted.
